pinyin: wǒ huí lai le! ā? wǒ men yǒu kè rén ā?
english: I'm back! Oh? Have we got a guest?

pinyin: bǎ wǒ de xīn gěi nǐ.
english: I give you my heart.

chinese: 这人讲的我完全听不懂。
pinyin: zhè rén jiǎng de wǒ wán quán tīng bu dǒng.
english: What he said was over my head.

pinyin: wǒ zuò le yī gè qí guài de mèng.
english: I had a strange dream.

pinyin: zhè méi yǒu rèn hé qū bié.
english: That makes no difference.

pinyin: wǒ zhī dào tā de dì zhǐ.
english: I know her address.

pinyin: wǒ huì zài nà zhī qián jiàn tā.
english: I'll see him before that.

chinese: 他在这方面不是很严格。
pinyin: tā zài zhè fāng miàn bù shì hěn yán gé.
english: He's not very strict about this.

pinyin: tā bù shì ge pǔ tōng de xué sheng.
english: He is no ordinary student.

pinyin: zài nǎ r wǒ néng zhǎo dào yá gāo?
english: Where can I find toothpaste?

pinyin: wǒ fù qīn zài nǎ lǐ?
english: Where is my dad?

pinyin: ràng wǒ wèi nǐ zuò zhè jiàn shì!
english: Let me do this for you.

pinyin: nǐ píng shén me jiào wǒ zǒu?
english: Who are you to tell me to get out?

chinese: “你什么时候回来？”“这都要看天气。”
pinyin: nǐ shén me shí hou huí lai? zhè dōu yào kàn tiān qì.
english: "When will you be back?" "It all depends on the weather."

pinyin: nǐ yǐ wèi wǒ zhēn yào hē ā?
english: Did you think I'd really drink that?

chinese: 我希望我们能保持联系。
pinyin: wǒ xī wàng wǒ men néng bǎo chí lián xì.
english: I hope we stay in touch.

pinyin: nǐ céng jīng dé guo zhòng bìng ma?
english: Have you ever had any serious illness?

chinese: 她对我来说是一个完全陌生的人。
pinyin: tā duì wǒ lái shuō shì yī gè wán quán mò shēng de rén.
english: She's a complete stranger to me.

pinyin: mā ma wèi wǒ zhǔn bèi le wǔ fàn.
english: Mother prepared lunch for me.

pinyin: zhè bèi rèn wéi shì yī jiàn dà shì.
english: This is considered to be a matter of great importance.

chinese: 交通事故没有一天是不在发生的。
pinyin: jiāo tōng shì gù méi yǒu yī tiān shì bù zài fā shēng de.
english: Not a day passes without traffic accidents.

pinyin: tā duì wǒ de chē zěn me kàn?
english: What does she think about my car?

pinyin: nǐ zài kàn tā ma?
english: Were you looking at him?

chinese: 你能看出有什么不同吗？
pinyin: nǐ néng kàn chū yǒu shén me bù tóng ma?
english: Can you see the difference?

pinyin: nǐ de xíng wéi wán quán hé fǎ.
english: Your conduct is perfectly legal.

pinyin: nǐ cái zuó tiān shéi lái zhǎo wǒ le?
english: Who do you think came to see me yesterday?

chinese: 你为什么不直接炒了他？
pinyin: nǐ wèi shén me bù zhí jiē chǎo le tā?
english: Why don't you just fire him?

pinyin: shéi cái shì wǒ zhēn zhèng de fù mǔ?
english: Who are my real parents?

pinyin: nǐ dú le wǒ de bào gào le ma?
english: Have you read my report?

pinyin: wǒ de tóu xiàng piào liang ma?
english: Is my profile picture beautiful?

chinese: 你来的时候我刚好要走。
pinyin: nǐ lái de shí hou wǒ gāng hǎo yào zǒu.
english: I was about to leave when you came in.

chinese: 你是我唯一可以信任的人。
pinyin: nǐ shì wǒ wéi yī kě yǐ xìn rèn de rén.
english: You're the only person I can trust.

pinyin: cún zài de yì yì shì shén me?
english: What's the point of existence?

pinyin: xiàn zài shì xíng dòng de shí hou le.
english: Now is the time to act.

chinese: 你尝过那么好喝的汤吗？
pinyin: nǐ cháng guo nà me hǎo hē de tāng ma?
english: Have you tasted such good soup before?

pinyin: wǒ shì yī gè hǎo rén.
english: I'm a good guy.

chinese: 这是本有趣的书，不是吗？
pinyin: zhè shì běn yǒu qù de shū, bù shì ma?
english: This is an interesting book, isn't it?

pinyin: nǐ zài kàn shéi?
english: Who are you looking at?

pinyin: bié zài wǒ miàn qián zài tí le!
english: Don't ever say this in my presence again!

pinyin: nǐ piàn le tā!
english: You lied to him!

chinese: 你认为我们会遇到好天气吗？
pinyin: nǐ rèn wéi wǒ men huì yù dào hǎo tiān qì ma?
english: Do you think we'll have good weather?

pinyin: nǐ yǒu gèng hǎo de lǐ yóu ma?
english: Do you have a better explanation?

pinyin: nǐ yǒu duō huán bǎo ya?
english: How green are you?

chinese: 我希望您快就会好起来。
pinyin: wǒ xī wàng nín kuài jiù huì hǎo qǐ lai.
english: I hope you'll soon get well.

chinese: 这是不是意味着你不会来了？
pinyin: zhè shì bù shì yì wèi zhe nǐ bù huì lái le?
english: Does that mean you won't come?

chinese: 昨晚我们听了总统在电视上的讲话。
pinyin: zuó wǎn wǒ men tīng le zǒng tǒng zài diàn shì shàng de jiǎng huà.
english: Yesterday evening we heard the President talk on television.

pinyin: tā jiào wǒ duì bié ren hǎo yī diǎn.
english: He told me to be kind to others.

pinyin: wǒ cái bù tīng nǐ shuō de ne!
english: I don't give a fuck about what you say!

pinyin: zhuā dào nǐ le!
english: Gotcha!

chinese: 现在的人教育程度比以前高得多。
pinyin: xiàn zài de rén jiào yù chéng dù bǐ yǐ qián gāo de duō.
english: People are more educated now than they used to be.

chinese: 橙子在我嘴里留下了一种奇怪的味道。
pinyin: chéng zi zài wǒ zuǐ lǐ liú xià le yī zhǒng qí guài de wèi dao.
english: The orange left a strange taste in my mouth.

chinese: 这是她曾经住过的房子。
pinyin: zhè shì tā céng jīng zhù guo de fáng zi.
english: This is the house where she used to live.

chinese: 我居然忘记了今天有课！
pinyin: wǒ jū rán wàng jì le jīn tiān yǒu kè!
english: I completely forgot that there was class today!

chinese: 这几天我脑袋里的事情太多了。
pinyin: zhè jǐ tiān wǒ nǎo dài lǐ de shì qing tài duō le.
english: I have too many things on my mind these days.

pinyin: nà dòng huī sè de dà lóu ma?
english: That gray building?

pinyin: wǒ huái yùn le.
english: I'm pregnant.

chinese: 学生不该忽略自己的身份。
pinyin: xué sheng bù gāi hū lüè zì jǐ de shēn fèn.
english: A student should not lose sight of his own identity.

pinyin: zhè shì wǒ qù shuì jiào de dì fang.
english: This is where I sleep.

chinese: 他不打算买一个摄像机。
pinyin: tā bù dǎ suàn mǎi yī gè shè xiàng jī.
english: He isn't going to buy a camera.

pinyin: zuó tiān wǒ qù hé biān diào yú le.
english: Yesterday I went and fished by the river.

pinyin: jiù wǒ suǒ zhī, tā bù lǎn.
english: As far as I know, he isn't lazy.

pinyin: wǒ huái yùn le ma?
english: Am I pregnant?

pinyin: bù yào zài wā nǐ de bí zi le.
english: Stop picking your nose.

chinese: 我们估计能在两周内到那个地方。
pinyin: wǒ men gū jì néng zài liǎng zhōu nèi dào nà ge dì fang.
english: We calculated that we could reach the place within two weeks.

pinyin: lún dào wǒ le ma?
english: Is it my turn?

pinyin: yǒu shéi xiǎng shā wǒ?
english: Who would want to kill me?

pinyin: wǒ gāi qù ma?
english: Should I go?

chinese: 这就是我跟你说的那个镇。
pinyin: zhè jiù shì wǒ gēn nǐ shuō de nà ge zhèn.
english: This is the town I told you about.

chinese: 我的父亲很快就会康复。
pinyin: wǒ de fù qīn hěn kuài jiù huì kāng fù.
english: My father will recover soon.

chinese: 我真的不应该再呆下去了。
pinyin: wǒ zhēn de bù yīng gāi zài dāi xià qù le.
english: I really shouldn't stay any longer.

chinese: 他是最后一个偷东西的人。
pinyin: tā shì zuì hòu yī gè tōu dōng xi de rén.
english: He is the last man to steal.

chinese: 我总是在离手不远的地方放一本字典。
pinyin: wǒ zǒng shì zài lí shǒu bù yuǎn de dì fang fàng yī běn zì diǎn.
english: I always keep a dictionary close at hand.

chinese: 我爸爸坚持要我去那地方看看。
pinyin: wǒ bà ba jiān chí yào wǒ qù nà dì fang kàn kan.
english: My father insisted that I should go to see the place.

pinyin: wǒ zhī hòu gāi zěn me zuò?
english: What should I do later?

pinyin: bà ba, nǐ gāng cái zài gàn má?
english: Father, What were you just doing?

chinese: 在雨中走出去是不可能的。
pinyin: zài yǔ zhōng zǒu chū qù shì bù kě néng de.
english: Going out in this rain is out of the question.

pinyin: wǒ xiǎng hái dài yī yè, xíng bù xíng?
english: I'd like to stay one more night. Is that possible?

pinyin: nǐ wèi shén me zhè me kě lián?
english: Why are you so unfortunate?

chinese: 我感觉困得几乎不能睁开我的眼睛了。
pinyin: wǒ gǎn jué kùn de jī hū bù néng zhēng kāi wǒ de yǎn jing le.
english: I felt so sleepy that I could hardly keep my eyes open.

pinyin: tā shuō de méi yǒu yī jù shí huà.
english: There isn't a grain of truth in what he says.

pinyin: tāng mu shì ge shén me yàng de rén?
english: What kind of a person is Tom?

chinese: 我之前不怎么想去滑雪。
pinyin: wǒ zhī qián bù zěn me xiǎng qù huá xuě.
english: I didn't really feel like going skiing.

pinyin: wǒ de yī wèi péng you bèi qiāng shā.
english: My friend was shot.

pinyin: wǒ gāi jǐ diǎn dào?
english: What time shall I come?

chinese: 这是个好地方，但我不想住在这儿。
pinyin: zhè shì gè hǎo dì fang, dàn wǒ bù xiǎng zhù zài zhè r.
english: This is a nice place, but I don't want to live here.

pinyin: zuó tiān nǐ huá xuě le ma?
english: Did you ski yesterday?

pinyin: tā de míng zi zhòng suǒ zhōu zhī.
english: Everyone knows his name.

pinyin: wǒ zěn me qù jǐng chá jú?
english: How do I get to the police?

chinese: 我去过上海周围的地方。
pinyin: wǒ qù guò shàng hǎi zhōu wéi de dì fang.
english: I've been to the area surrounding Shanghai.

chinese: 他是跟他爸爸去杭州的吗？
pinyin: tā shì gēn tā bà ba qù háng zhōu de ma?
english: Did he go to Hangzhou with his dad?

pinyin: suǒ yǒu rén dōu shì píng děng de.
english: All people are equal.

chinese: 要等它踢完啊，有一点时间啦！
pinyin: yào děng tā tī wán ā, yǒu yī diǎn shí jiān lā!
english: We've got to wait for them to finish playing - there's still a while to go!

pinyin: nǐ shì guò zhòng xīn qǐ dòng tā ma?
english: Have you tried rebooting it?

chinese: 什么都逃不过我的法眼。
pinyin: shén me dōu táo bù guò wǒ de fǎ yǎn.
english: Nothing escapes my eye.

pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng dǎ jī nǐ de.
english: I didn't mean to discourage you.

chinese: 是在这点上我们的意见有分歧。
pinyin: shì zài zhè diǎn shàng wǒ men de yì jiàn yǒu fēn qí.
english: It's on this point that our opinions differ.

pinyin: zhè kě bu shì wǒ zuò de.
english: I didn't do this.

chinese: 他是个很安静的人，头顶有点秃。
pinyin: tā shì ge hěn ān jìng de rén, tóu dǐng yǒu diǎn tū.
english: He's a quiet man, a little bald on top.

pinyin: nǐ zài gé lóu shàng zuò le shén me?
english: What were you doing in the attic?

pinyin: nǐ de tí yì zhí de kǎo lǜ.
english: Your suggestion is worth considering.

pinyin: tā de zhōng gào zǒng shì hěn míng zhì.
english: His advice is always very sensible.

chinese: 让我们来澄清一下这个问题。
pinyin: ràng wǒ men lái chéng qīng yī xià zhè ge wèn tí.
english: Let's clear up this problem.

chinese: 你将会和我一起去购物吗？
pinyin: nǐ jiāng huì hé wǒ yī qǐ qù gòu wù ma?
english: Will you go shopping with me?

pinyin: xiǎo jiā huo, nǐ zài kàn shén me?
english: What are you looking at, little one?

pinyin: wǒ zhēn de hěn dǎo méi!
english: How unlucky I am!

chinese: 上帝明白我们尽了全力。
pinyin: shàng dì míng bai wǒ men jìn le quán lì.
english: God knows we did everything we could.

chinese: 我的屁股穿这个看起来大吗？
pinyin: wǒ de pì gu chuān zhè ge kàn qǐ lai dà ma?
english: Does my bum look big in this?

chinese: 我每天至少用一次煎鍋。
pinyin: wǒ měi tiān zhì shǎo yòng yī cì jiān guō.
english: I use a frying pan at least once a day.

chinese: 我的想法和你的不一样。
pinyin: wǒ de xiǎng fǎ hé nǐ de bù yī yàng.
english: My opinion differs from yours.

pinyin: nǐ shuō de wǒ chán sǐ le!
english: The way you describe it makes me drool.

pinyin: wǒ huì jǐn kě néng bāng nǐ de.
english: I will help you as far as I can.

pinyin: wǒ de yuè jīng méi lái.
english: My period hasn't come.

pinyin: lǎo tiān! wǒ shā le yī gè yùn fù!
english: Oh my god! I've killed a pregnant woman!

pinyin: tā men bù xiǎng hé wǒ shuō huà.
english: They don't want to talk to me.

chinese: 由于火车延误，我迟到了。
pinyin: yóu yú huǒ chē yán wu, wǒ chí dào le.
english: I was late as a result of the train delay.

pinyin: wǒ yào zěn me shàng tiān táng?
english: How can I get to heaven?

pinyin: tā bù shì ái zhèng sǐ de.
english: He did not die of cancer.

pinyin: tā hé wǒ shì xiōng dì.
english: He and I are brothers.

pinyin: zhì yù de xī wàng yǒu duō dà?
english: What hope is there of a cure?

chinese: 我们很快会谈到这个的。
pinyin: wǒ men hěn kuài huì tán dào zhè ge de.
english: We will talk about this soon.

chinese: 你什么时候看见过冰雹吗？
pinyin: nǐ shén me shí hou kàn jiàn guo bīng báo ma?
english: Have you ever seen it hail?

pinyin: nǐ de xìng shì zěn me xiě?
english: How is your surname written?

pinyin: wǒ zhǐ wàng nǐ le.
english: I am counting on you.

pinyin: yān cóng yān cōng lǐ mào le chū lái.
english: The smoke went upward through the chimney.

pinyin: guò lai hé wǒ tiào wǔ ā!
english: Come and dance with me!

pinyin: nín huǐ diào le wǒ de bǎo mǎ!
english: You ruined my BMW!

pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng zài rě shì le.
english: I don't want to cause any more trouble.

pinyin: tā lì yòng le wǒ de wú zhī.
english: She took advantage of my ignorance.

chinese: 他看到我的时候和我说话。
pinyin: tā kàn dào wǒ de shí hou hé wǒ shuō huà.
english: He spoke to me when he saw me.

pinyin: ná shàng nǐ men de zhǐ nán zhēn.
english: Bring your compass along.

chinese: 我已經告訴我的父母了。
pinyin: wǒ yǐ jīng gào su wǒ de fù mǔ le.
english: I already told my parents.

chinese: 他不知道这些东西的归属。
pinyin: tā bù zhī dào zhè xiē dōng xi de guī shǔ.
english: He's unaware of who possesses them.
